name: Strong Kangen Water
description: Strong Kangen Water is the most alkaline water produced by the machine, with a pH range of 11.0 to 11.5. It is not meant for drinking, but it is excellent for deep cleaning, degreasing, food preparation, and removing stubborn residues from kitchen tools and household surfaces. Enagic describes this water as highly effective for dissolving oils and helping with cleaning tasks around the home.
uses: Cleaning vegetables, fruits, and grains to help remove pesticide residue and impurities
Pre-soaking vegetables and beans to reduce cooking time and improve softness
Degreasing kitchen counters, stovetops, sinks, and cutting boards
Removing tough stains from clothes, utensils, and household surfaces
Cleaning bathrooms, glass, tiles, and floors without harsh chemicals
Washing produce before cooking or eating

name: Kangen Water (pH 9.5)
description: Kangen Water at pH 9.5 is the signature drinking water for most users. It is highly alkaline and is rich in minerals and molecular hydrogen, which Enagic promotes as antioxidant-supporting water for daily wellness. This is the most popular water for regular drinking, cooking, and beverage preparation because it is balanced, smooth, and easy to use every day.
uses: Daily drinking water for everyday hydration
Making tea, coffee, soups, and juices
Cooking rice, pasta, grains, and vegetables
Preparing soups, broths, and healthy meals
Refreshing water for family use and guests
Adding to smoothies, herbal drinks, and homemade beverages

name: Kangen Water (pH 9.0)
description: Kangen Water at pH 9.0 is a slightly milder alkaline option that is ideal for those who are just beginning their alkaline water routine or prefer a gentler drinking water. It still offers the smooth taste and mineral-rich feel associated with Kangen Water, and it is commonly used for everyday hydration and cooking because it is easy to incorporate into daily life.
uses: Daily drinking for beginners and regular household use
Preparing food, soups, and sauces
Mixing with juices, tea, or cereals
Hydrating throughout the day in a gentle alkaline form
Compatible with general home consumption and cooking
Helpful for people looking for a less intense alkaline profile

name: Kangen Water (pH 8.5)
description: Kangen Water at pH 8.5 is the gentlest alkaline option in the lineup, making it a perfect starting point for first-time users, older adults, and children. It offers a subtle alkaline profile with a clean, refreshing taste and is often used when someone wants the benefits of Kangen Water in a softer, milder form.
uses: A gentle introduction to alkaline drinking water
Daily hydration for children, seniors, and sensitive users
Suitable for people who prefer a milder alkalinity level
Cooking, making beverages, and family meals
Hydrating pets and keeping a smooth refreshing water supply at home
Good for households transitioning from regular drinking water

name: Clean Water
description: Clean Water is neutral filtered water with a pH of 7.0. It is produced by the machine as filtered, purified water without the ionization process. This water is commonly chosen when a balanced, neutral taste is desired and is useful for drinking, cooking, and situations where alkaline water is not preferred. It is ideal for general household use and for those who want the purity of filtered water.
uses: General drinking water for the whole family
Preparing baby formula as advised by medical professionals
Taking medications or supplements where neutral water is preferred
Filling water bottles, jugs, and daily-use containers
Use in appliances, humidifiers, or places where neutral pH is desired
Daily cooking and cleaning where filtered water is needed

name: Beauty Water
description: Beauty Water is slightly acidic water with a pH between 5.5 and 6.0. Enagic promotes it as a skin and hair-friendly water because it helps maintain a fresh and conditioned feeling after cleansing. This water is especially popular for skincare routines, hair care, and refreshing the skin in a gentle, non-stripping way.
uses: Facial cleansing and toning for refreshed skin
Hair rinse after shampoo to add shine and smoothness
Refreshing skin mist during the day
After-sun cooling and skin refreshment
Cleaning makeup brushes and beauty tools
Helping maintain a clean, refreshed feeling for personal care routines

name: Strong Acidic Water
description: Strong Acidic Water is the most acidic water produced by the machine, with a pH range of 2.5 to 2.7. It is not for drinking and should only be used externally. Enagic positions it as a powerful sanitizing water for hygiene-oriented tasks such as cleaning surfaces, refreshing personal care items, and supporting household sanitation around the home.
uses: Sanitizing kitchen surfaces, cutting boards, and countertops
Cleaning and disinfecting small household items and utensils
Refreshing toothbrushes, dental accessories, and personal hygiene items
Cleaning pet areas and grooming tools
External face, skin, or wound cleansing when appropriate and under guidance
Removing mold, mildew, and germs from household surfaces
